definitions.full: H392. Akzib אַכְזִיב proper name, of a location 1. in lowland of Judah Josh 15:44 ( ᵐ5 Ακιεζει καὶ Κεζειβ , ᵐ5 L Αχζειβ ), Micah 1:14 ( ᵐ5 οἴκους ματαίους ; see also כֹּזֵבָא כְּזִיב, ). 2 in Asher Judg 1:31 ( ᵐ5 Ασχαζει ), and ( אַכְזִ֫יבָה ) Josh 19:29 ( ᵐ5 Εχοζοβ , A Αχζειφ , ᵐ5 L Αχαζειβ ); it lay on the coast south of Tyre, in Assyrian Akzibi, COT 19:29 Dl Par. 284 ; Greek Εκδιππα ; modern ez-Zîb , Bd Pal. 272 Buhl G. § 120 and (on pronunciation) Kasteren ZPV xiii. 101 . כזר (√ of following; Aramaic Ethpe`el be cruel ( ᵑ7 Job 10:1 ), compare Syriac , miles, vir strenuus PS 1718 , who compare Persian athleta, heros (Vullers)).
